what: Seller reports receiving a second sale ever on Gumroad on May 1, 2025, and describes low confidence in digital pricing despite a decade of physical product selling experience.
verbatim_snippet: "I know Gumroad can be a big earner, but I just haven't got the confidence to sell my stuff yet. The easiest thing to mess with our head is how to price our product or services, and how much the buyer is really willing to pay?"
date: Accessed April 2026; content references May 1, 2025 sale
notes: Recovery method: Google search index snippet. Author is Bin Jiang. Also cross-posted on Medium. Experienced physical-product seller ($2M+ Amazon/eBay 2014–2019). Two products on Gumroad.
